relations.subject: Charles Henry Tawney
relations.evidence: educated at Rugby School and Trinity College, Cambridge; where he was a Cambridge Apostle and worked as a fellow and tutor for four years

relations.subject: Charles Henry Tawney
relations.evidence: worked as a fellow and tutor for four years, until he moved to India for health reasons.

relations.subject: Charles Henry Tawney
relations.evidence: From 1865 to his retirement in 1892 he held various educational offices, most significantly Principal of Presidency College Calcutta, for much of the period of 1875 to 1892.

relations.subject: Jagadish Chandra Bose
relations.evidence: One of the professors of Presidency College during Tawney's tenure was Jagadish Chandra Bose.

relations.subject: Charles Henry Tawney
relations.evidence: After retirement, Tawney was made Librarian of the India Office.

relations.subject: Richard Henry Tawney
relations.evidence: He married Constance Catharine Fox in 1867 and had a large family. One of his children, born 30 November 1880 in Calcutta, was Richard Henry Tawney.
